cm_open6.text: Make me any friend you like, with six parts in all!

cm_open10.text: Make me any friend you like, with ten parts in all!

cm_open15.text: Make me any friend you like, with fifteen parts in all!

cm_yes.text: Yes! Just how I wanted it!

cm_not.text: Hmm. Let's count all its parts.

rg_intro.text: Roll a giant! Every fact you know adds clay.

rg_make.text: Now make it a giant! Poke in eyes, and pull out arms!

rg_best.text: A new best! It gets a crown!

rg_welcome.text: Every giant is welcome in the row!

pq_intro.text: Let's have a parade! Stretch the mat to make the rows.

pq_m3x4.text: Three rows of four make twelve!

pq_m2x5.text: Two rows of five make ten!

pq_m4x4.text: Four rows of four make sixteen!

pq_m6x7.text: Six rows of seven make forty-two!

pq_m6x8.text: Six rows of eight make forty-eight!

pq_m7x8.text: Seven rows of eight make fifty-six!

pq_swapped.text: Nearly! Count the rows again. Turn it round!

pq_turn.text: Now turn it round! Twist the block, or press the turn button.

pq_15.text: Fifteen critters! Make a block with no gaps.

pq_block.text: A block with no gaps! Well done!

pq_every12.text: Find every way to march twelve!

pq_every18.text: Find every way to march eighteen! A block turned round counts once.

pq_another.text: Another way! Can you find more?

pq_left.text: Some critters have no place. Try another row size?

pq_13.text: Thirteen critters! Can they march in a block?

pq_13yes.text: Thirteen only marches in one long line!

pq_prime.text: A number like that is called a prime number.

pq_split.text: Swipe down the block to split it in two!

pq_splitdone.text: Two blocks, and still the same critters!

sp_intro.text: Squish Pairs! Drag one ball onto another.

sp_100.text: Squish two that make one hundred!

sp_not.text: Not those two. Try another pair!

sp_hint.text: Which ball goes with this one?

pr_tip.text: Hmm, not quite. Have another look!

pr_quick.text: Now the quick ones! As fast as you can!

vp_intro.text: Let's wake up the volcano! Every right answer makes it rumble.

vp_dots.text: No hurry! Look at the dots.

vp_best.text: A new best! Look how high!

kc_intro.text: Race you! Every right answer is a boost!

kc_dots.text: No hurry! Look at the dots, then type.

kc_time.text: Time's up! Let's look at the board.

kc_win.text: You won! That was a great race!

kc_lose.text: That was close! Shall we race again?

kc_calm.text: We made it! What a race!

kc_jump.text: Three in a row! A big jump!

bt_intro.text: Welcome to my bakery! Everything has to come out on time.

bt_set.text: Into the oven! Set the clock for when it comes out.

bt_late.text: Oh no, burnt! That's too late.

bt_read.text: When is it ready? Read the clock.

bt_tip_steps.text: Hmm. What do we need before that?

bt_day_or_night.text: Look out of the window. Is it day or night?

bt_tip_window.text: Look at the window. What's in the sky?

bt_which_part.text: What part of the day is it?

bt_part_sleep.text: When do we go to sleep?

bt_part_order.text: Morning, afternoon, night. Tap them in order!

bt_after_day.text: Which day comes after this one?

bt_before_day.text: Which day comes before this one?

bt_how_many_days.text: How many days in a week?

bt_today_is.text: Here's today. And yesterday we baked this.

bt_tip_today.text: Yesterday is just before today. Tomorrow is just after.

bt_month_after.text: Which month comes after this one?

bt_how_many_months.text: How many months in a year?

bt_one_week.text: We bake this every week. One week later, which day is it?

bt_tip_cal.text: A week has seven days. Each row is one week.

bt_which_thing.text: Which one happens at this time?

bt_am_is.text: a.m. is the morning, before noon.

bt_pm_is.text: p.m. is after noon, until night.

bt_tip_ampm.text: Morning is a.m. After noon is p.m.

bt_end.text: Everything baked on time! Thank you!

sg_intro.text: Up we go! Help me fly through the right gates, all the way to the Sky Island!

sg_watch.text: Watch me! I'll fly through it.

sg_again.text: Let's look for that one again!

sg_last.text: The last gate! Fly through the star!

sg_same.text: Fly through the gate that's the same shape!

sg_c0.text: Fly through the gate with no corners!

sg_c3.text: Fly through the gate with three corners!

sg_c4.text: Fly through the gate with four corners!

sg_more.text: Fly through the gate with more corners than this one!

sg_s3.text: Fly through the gate with three sides!

sg_s4.text: Fly through the gate with four sides!

sg_s5.text: Fly through the gate with five sides!

sg_s6.text: Fly through the gate with six sides!

sg_in.text: Fly through the ring in the basket!

sg_on.text: Fly through the ring on top of the balloon!

sg_under.text: Fly through the ring under the basket!

sg_front.text: Fly in front of the rainbow!

sg_between.text: Fly between the rainbow and the cloud!

sg_tip_circle.text: A circle is round all the way, with no corners.

sg_tip_square.text: A square has four sides, all the same. Let's count the corners!

sg_tip_triangle.text: A triangle has three corners. Let's count!

sg_tip_rect.text: A rectangle has four corners, with two long sides and two short sides.

sg_tip_oval.text: An oval is round, and long like an egg.

sg_tip_hex.text: A hexagon has six sides. Let's count the corners!

sg_tip_pent.text: A pentagon has five sides. Let's count the corners!

sg_tip_s4.text: Look for four sides. Let's count the corners!

sg_tip_same.text: Look at the shape, not the colour!

sg_tip_turned.text: A shape turned round is still the same shape!

sg_tip_size.text: Big or small, it's still the same shape!

sg_tip_corners.text: Let's count the corners on this one!

sg_tip_more.text: This one has more corners. Let's count!

sg_tip_real.text: Three straight sides, all joined up!

sg_tip_on.text: On means on top of it!

sg_tip_beside.text: Beside means right at its side!

sg_tip_front.text: In front means nearer to us!

sg_tip_behind.text: Behind means further away. The rainbow hides part of it!

sg_tip_nextto.text: Next to means right beside it!

sg_tip_between.text: Between means in the middle of the two!

tt_ask.text: What's the time? Read my clock!

tt_intro.text: Let's play What's the time, Mr Wolf! Creep up on me while my back is turned. Read my clock right to take a step.

tt_tomorrow.text: Today is the day with the ring. What day is tomorrow?

tt_yesterday.text: Today is the day with the ring. What day was yesterday?

tt_ask_week.text: Think about the calendar. Which one is right?

tt_ask_month.text: Which month comes after the one on the card?

tt_ampm.text: Is it in the morning, a.m., or after midday, p.m.?

tt_tip_short.text: The short hand tells the hour.

tt_tip_long.text: The long hand tells the minutes. Count in fives round the clock.

tt_tip_half.text: When the long hand points down to the six, it's half past.

tt_tip_today.text: Tomorrow is just after today. Yesterday is just before today.

tt_tip_calendar.text: Look at how the calendar is grouped.

tt_tip_ampm.text: a.m. is from midnight to midday. p.m. is after midday.

tt_show_hour.text: First, look at the short hand.

tt_show_minute.text: Now look at the long hand.

tt_show_days.text: Follow the days in order to the empty place.

tt_show_today.text: Start at today. Move to the day we need.

tt_show_calendar.text: Count the groups on the calendar.

tt_show_ampm.text: Look at what I am doing, and the sky. Now match that part of the day.

tt_show_answer.text: Here is the answer. Then you can try a fresh one.

ms_intro.text: I've hidden a shape in my sack! Can you guess which one?

ms_tap_out.text: Tap all the shapes it can't be!

ms_fits.text: Oh! That one fits the clue. It could be in my sack!

ms_tip_look.text: Look at each shape. Does it match the clue? Tap the ones that don't.

ms_last.text: Only one left! Let's look in my sack.

ms_twin.text: Let's play again! I'll hide another one.

ms_solid.text: My shape is solid, not flat.

ms_stacks.text: You can build on top of my shape.

ms_curved.text: My shape has a curved side.

ms_nocurve.text: My shape has no curves at all.

ms_faces0.text: My shape has no flat faces.

ms_faces1.text: My shape has one flat face.

ms_faces2.text: My shape has two flat faces.

ms_faces5.text: My shape has five flat faces.

ms_faces6.text: My shape has six flat faces.

ms_is_can.text: It's a cylinder, like a can!

lt_intro.text: It's party night! Help me light up the windows.

lt_light_half.text: Light half of this window! Then tap Lights on.
